UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user workspace preferences, selected city, theme, and household sensitivity calibration.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: User display name without private email PII.

selectedCity.description: Active city monitored by the user.

joinedPledges.description: Bounded list of joined community initiative IDs.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

DailyImpactLog.title: DailyImpactLog
DailyImpactLog.description: Per-day household routine completions, PM2.5 reduction percentage, and avoided CO2 grams.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the log owner.

dateId.description: Local calendar date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

city.description: City for which actions were logged.

completedIds.description: Bounded array of completed routine item IDs.

pm25ReductionPct.description: Cumulative estimated PM2.5 exposure reduction percentage.

co2SavedGrams.description: Total grams of CO2e avoided on this date.

ChatMessageDoc.title: ChatMessageDoc
ChatMessageDoc.description: Persisted multi-turn Gemini chatbot conversation message scoped to the owning user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the chat owner.

model.description: Gemini model identifier used for this turn.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was recorded.

CommunityPledge.title: CommunityPledge
CommunityPledge.description: Verified neighborhood clean-air pledge posted by an authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the pledge author.

authorName.description: Public first name or display handle (no email PII).

city.description: City where the community pledge applies.

/users/{userId}.description: Private owner-only user profile and household calibration.

/users/{userId}/impactLogs/{dateId}.description: Owner-only daily routine impact and 7-day CO2 savings logs.

/users/{userId}/chatMessages/{messageId}.description: Owner-only multi-turn Gemini chatbot conversation thread.

/communityPledges/{pledgeId}.description: Shared city clean-air pledges readable by signed-in users and writable only by the verified owner.
